nodes.note: Measured, not asserted. The Class A token 0x7712c34205737192402172409a8f7ccef8aa2aec is a 703-byte hand-rolled delegatecall proxy, NOT EIP-1967. Its runtime exposes exactly four functions, owner() 0x8da5cb5b, target() 0xd4b83992, setOwner(address) 0x13af4035 and setTarget(address) 0x776d1a01, with storage slot 0 the owner and slot 1 the implementation, and a fallback that delegatecalls to slot 1. Live target() = 0x603bb6909be14f83282e03632280d91be7fb83b2 (17,236 bytes). The I-Class token is a standard EIP-1967 proxy with implementation 0x9e2693f54831f6f52b0bb952c2935d26919a3626. Read by direct JSON-RPC against eth.llamarpc.com and ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com on 2026-08-04. Up names the facility and stops there; F13 is what the facility is worth.

nodes.label: F13 the party who holds that replacement power is one private key: the pro
nodes.text: the party who holds that replacement power is one private key: the proxy owner is an externally owned account, with no multisig at the proxy layer and no delay of any kind
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and this is the finding the corpus's decomposition failed to record. owner() on the Class A proxy is 0xe01605f6b6dc593b7d2917f4a0940db2a625b09e, which returns eth_getCode = 0x and nonce 10 on two independent RPC endpoints, so it is an externally owned account, not a contract; the I-Class proxy has the SAME EOA owner. One private key can call setTarget and replace the entire implementation of a multi-hundred-million-dollar BlackRock fund token, immediately. THIS ARMS PROHIBITION X9 (Up with immediate single-key control, class H), and the corpus records armedProhibitions as empty for BUIDL, so this is a finding about the decomposition process rather than about the vocabulary. It is stated here as an obligation ABOUT THE HOLDER rather than about the facility because that is exactly what the vocabulary cannot carry: Up says a mutable implementation exists, and it cannot express who may mutate it, how fast, or with what independence. Tg is correctly absent and its absence is not neutrality but the alarming case: there is no timelock because there is no governance, only a key. This is the same party-sort gap the 07-bridges lane exhibited on the three largest wrapped-asset bridges. L15 (Up implies Tg or a bounded emergency process) is NOT discharged.

nodes.label: F14 the same fund issues a legally distinct share class on each chain, pri
nodes.text: the same fund issues a legally distinct share class on each chain, priced with a different management fee, against one off-chain register, and movement between chains is a third-party service the fund disclaims
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and a DEPARTURE that REVERSES a corpus attribution. Xf and Xm are REFUTED as BUIDL's own mechanisms and are dropped from the construction. Ethereum, Arbitrum and Optimism carry 50 bps; Aptos, Avalanche, Polygon and Solana carry 20 bps. Verbatim: bridging is provided by a 3rd party provider and availability cannot be guaranteed at all times or between all blockchains. If Xm belongs to anything it belongs to Wormhole, and Xf describes a facility the fund disclaims. There is no symbol for ONE OBLIGOR, N TOKENS, ONE REGISTER, which is a different object from a claim moved between domains. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE CORPUS: identicalClaimedByLane records USYC and BUIDL as identical; they are not, they differ by at least four symbols as the corpus itself writes them, and the cross-domain attribution between the two is REVERSED, since USYC is natively issued on three chains with dedicated cross-chain tellers while BUIDL disclaims bridging entirely.

nodes.label: F15 the holder must know who owes them the money and what recourse they ha
nodes.text: the holder must know who owes them the money and what recourse they have, and here the obligor is a BVI company whose sponsor has expressly disclaimed any obligation to support it and whose gating powers are unknowable
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Obligor: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd., a BVI limited company incorporated 2023, registered office care of 50 Hudson Yards, New York, relying on 3(c)(7) and 506(c), board on the current filing Ian Pilgrim (Bermuda), W. William Woods (Cayman), Noelle L'Heureux (San Francisco) and Jennifer Collins (Carne Group, Cayman). Recourse: the sponsor has no legal obligation to provide financial support at any time, so a holder's remedy is a claim against the BVI company under private subscription documents. UNKNOWN: the board's suspension or gating power. The fund is not an EDGAR reporting company and files only Form D, and the subscription documents are not public, so no gate may be asserted in either direction. No element of the 58 names an obligor, a recourse position, or a suspension power.

nodes.label: F16 the holder must know whether their claim survives the fund's insolvenc
nodes.text: the holder must know whether their claim survives the fund's insolvency, and here it is unsecured equity: no security interest, no collateral agent, no bankruptcy-remoteness claim and no perfection step anywhere
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and the contrast within the category is the point. Ondo asserts a first-priority perfected security interest with a named collateral agent and control agreements; BUIDL asserts nothing of the kind, because a share is not a secured claim. Nothing on the product page, in the Form D, or in the DS Protocol interfaces creates or perfects any security interest, and no non-consolidation or true-sale opinion is referenced. A BUIDL holder ranks behind the fund's creditors, and no on-chain artefact records that, tests it, or changes on it. Of the five products in this category exactly one claims perfection, and the vocabulary cannot state the difference between the two positions.

nodes.label: F17 the holder must know what the reserve holds and who custodies it, and
nodes.text: the holder must know what the reserve holds and who custodies it, and here the only public statement of the portfolio is a marketing phrase and the custodian could not be established at a primary source
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The whole of the public portfolio policy is core investments of overnight repo and 3-month Treasuries. UNKNOWN: BNY Mellon's role split between fund administrator, custodian and digital-asset custody could not be confirmed at a primary source; the product page's institutional-grade custody section did not render entity names on scrape and press assertions are Tier 4 and are declined. The corpus's claim that the custodian's failure is the dominant tail risk and is unnameable is probably right, but the custodian's identity is not established here and must not be asserted.

nodes.label: F18 no independent attestation of the fund's assets is published anywhere
nodes.text: no independent attestation of the fund's assets is published anywhere obtainable: there is no holdings feed, no reserve report, no oracle and no covenant
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and a DEPARTURE: At is DROPPED from the corpus construction for BUIDL. The corpus emits At and stage 1 found no evidence for it. L27 requires a named attester, independence, a stated assurance level, a staleness bound and recourse, and not one of the five is evidenced for BUIDL, so At cannot be discharged at all rather than being merely approximate. This makes BUIDL the largest fund in the category with the smallest construction, six symbols, all of them access-control, freeze, redemption, share accounting and upgradeability, which is precisely the corpus's own category verdict that the vocabulary's RWA coverage is an access-control and upgrade-authority coverage.

nodes.label: F19 the holder must know who may change what the money is invested in, and
nodes.text: the holder must know who may change what the money is invested in, and here the manager can change duration, issuer mix and repo exposure at will with nothing on chain constraining it
nodes.note: RESIDUE, confirmed as unnameable. Nothing on chain constrains duration, issuer mix or repo exposure; there is no oracle, no holdings feed and no covenant, so the manager can change the entire risk profile of the instrument without touching a contract and no element in the vocabulary is sensitive to that. Sv is not emitted anywhere in this spec: BUIDL has no on-chain determination for Sv to attach to, since there is no price to set and no loss to mark, so investment discretion here is residue in the purest form of the five.

nodes.label: Centrifuge (Centrifuge Protocol V3)
F1 an investor subscribes an asset into a vault attached to a share class
nodes.text: an investor subscribes an asset into a vault attached to a share class of a pool and receives a share token that represents a claim on the pool's assets and rises in price rather than in balance
nodes.note: Live flagship: JTRSY 0x8c213ee79581ff4984583c6a801e5263418c4b86, 792,751,306.27 shares at 1.111749542989796511, that is $881.3M, read from the protocol's own public GraphQL at https://api.centrifuge.io (accessed 2026-08-04); JAAA $684.79M, ACRDX $43.45M, SPXA $3.37M, total primary share tokens $1.613B. Ix was considered and NOT emitted: the price rises because a manager posts a higher number (F4), not because any accrual rule computes one, so there is no index object. That distinction is exactly what separates Centrifuge from Ondo's USDY, where Ix is exact.

nodes.label: F2 subscription and redemption are asynchronous: a request is placed, the
nodes.text: subscription and redemption are asynchronous: a request is placed, the issuer approves a batch, shares are issued or revoked, the batch is fulfilled and only then may the investor claim
nodes.note: The ERC-7540 lifecycle is pending, approved, issued or revoked, fulfilled, claimed, and the ISSUER controls approval. Ep carries the mechanism; Wq is DROPPED as a DEPARTURE from the corpus, because there is no queue, no ordering, no position and no liquidity trigger, only a batch the issuer approves. This is the exact mirror image of Maple, where Wq is right and Ep is wrong, and a decomposition that gives both symbols to both protocols loses the distinction. Sync-deposit vaults (ERC-4626 plus ERC-7540) skip the request phase for deposits only, so the asynchrony is one-sided in that configuration.

nodes.label: F3 redemption is a first-class protocol operation with its own dedicated
nodes.text: redemption is a first-class protocol operation with its own dedicated transfer-hook regime, and it is conditional on the issuer approving the batch and setting its execution price
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: the corpus omits Rd and it should be present with a conditionality note, which is the qualification Rd needs everywhere in this category. The BatchRequestManager 0xc52Bd1Bd..3dFe77 sets the execution price for individual deposit and redemption batches SEPARATELY from the published reference price, so the price at which a holder actually exits is a second discretionary number distinct from the NAV, which is why Sv is emitted here as well as at F4. A dedicated RedemptionRestrictions hook 0xE5423eD8..17f06 exists to gate the redemption leg specifically.

nodes.label: F4 the value of every share is a single number one party posts on chain,
nodes.text: the value of every share is a single number one party posts on chain, with the freshness timestamp supplied by that same party, and no dispute window, challenge bond, deviation bound or staleness rejection anywhere in the call path
nodes.note: Hub.updateSharePrice(PoolId, ShareClassId, D18 pricePoolPerShare, uint64 computedAt) at lines 314 to 323, guarded by _isManager(poolId) and nothing else, with computedAt a CALLER-SUPPLIED ARGUMENT rather than taken from the block. A pool's NAV is typically computed offchain, for example from a portfolio held with a bank or custodian, and the issuer publishes the resulting share price to the hub. Third-party oracles do not repair this: the documented Chronicle integration reads the oracle and calls THE SAME SETTER. Ex is emitted as the closest symbol and is APPROXIMATE in the corpus's own marker sense, since Ex presumes an adversarial or aggregated feed. Oa does not apply, there being no assertion and dispute game. DEPARTURE: At is DROPPED. There is no named independent attester, no assurance level, no staleness bound and no recourse, so L27 cannot be discharged at all; contrast USYC, which does have a named administrator and auditor and where At is retained but scoped to NAV rather than reserves. NAV manipulation is the primary failure mode of this design and it has no representation.

nodes.label: F5 that price is authoritative on one chain and a message-derived copy ev
nodes.text: that price is authoritative on one chain and a message-derived copy everywhere else, propagated only when somebody pays gas for it, and a per-chain manager may override the local copy with a different number
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Propagation is a separate explicit act, hub.notifySharePrice(poolId, scId, centrifugeId, msg.sender) per destination network, with no automatic propagation and no freshness check at the consuming end, so a spoke can carry a stale price indefinitely if nobody pushes. BalanceSheet.overridePricePoolPerShare additionally lets a spoke-side manager set a DIFFERENT price locally (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/centrifuge/protocol/v3.2.0/src/core/spoke/BalanceSheet.sol line 266, accessed 2026-08-04). Xm names verified messaging; it cannot say the canonical accounting lives on chain A while chain B trades a copy that may be stale or locally overridden.

nodes.label: F6 who may hold a share token is decided by a transfer hook chosen per sh
nodes.text: who may hold a share token is decided by a transfer hook chosen per share class from a shipped set, replaceable without redeploying the token, and the hook knows which operation it is gating
nodes.note: Share tokens are ERC-20 extended with ERC-1404 and a modular hook system. Four hooks are deployed plus the option of none: FullRestrictions 0x8E680873..24a4, FreelyTransferable 0x2a9B9C14..1A61, RedemptionRestrictions 0xE5423eD8..17f06, FreezeOnly. The hook is ACTION-AWARE, distinguishing deposit requests, deposit claims, redemption requests, redemption claims, cross-chain transfers and peer-to-peer transfers, so different rules apply to different operation types, which Aw cannot carry. DOCUMENTATION DEFECT worth recording for stage 3: the docs site says FreelyTransferable requires memberlist membership for deposits and redemptions while the repository's own src/hooks/README.md says it always returns true for transfer checks (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/centrifuge/protocol/v3.2.0/src/hooks/README.md, accessed 2026-08-04); the code is authoritative and the docs page is wrong.

nodes.label: F7 eligibility carries an expiry: membership is stored as a valid-until t
nodes.text: eligibility carries an expiry: membership is stored as a valid-until timestamp packed into the same storage slot as the balance, so a holder ceases to be eligible with no actor doing anything
nodes.note: RESIDUE. BaseTransferHook encodes member validity and freeze status in the hookData structure (bytes16), the first 8 bytes a uint64 memberlist valid-until timestamp and the least significant bit the freeze status, packed into the same 256-bit slot as the balance. Aw is a bit; this is a bit with a clock. Independently found in the same shape at BUIDL, whose registry attributes also carry an expiry, so this is a category-level gap rather than one protocol's quirk.

nodes.label: F8 a pool manager can freeze an address and can take shares from a wallet
nodes.text: a pool manager can freeze an address and can take shares from a wallet and move them elsewhere, and a dedicated recovery contract is deployed for it
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: the corpus omits Fz for Centrifuge and it is a clear omission. Verified in source at tag v3.2.0: transferSharesFrom at line 136 is guarded isManager(poolId), refuses to pull from an endorsed contract, and calls token.authTransferFrom on the auth-gated ShareToken; issue and revoke at lines 156 and 232 are likewise isManager. The docs name it explicitly, recover tokens from a lost wallet by forced transfer via balance sheet transferSharesFrom, alongside a per-address freeze flag in token storage. A TokenRecoverer 0x1E70530e9555711f8DF4838Ab940b97c039B4037 is deployed. Centrifuge therefore has MORE explicit freeze and forced-transfer machinery than USYC, which the corpus does credit with Fz.

nodes.label: F9 a restricted share can be wrapped into a freely transferable token tha
nodes.text: a restricted share can be wrapped into a freely transferable token that trades on top of it, while the right to mint or redeem remains behind the identity gate
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and the category's cleanest instance of laundering a permissioned claim into a permissionless one. Issuers can wrap existing tokenized securities into freely transferable tokens while mint and redeem functions stay at KYC endpoints. Live: deJTRSY 0xa6233014b9b7aaa74f38fa1977ffc7a89642dc72, 18 decimals, supply 5,005,320.37 at price 1.032850, with its own hook 0xd51d8450..a2a0, plus deJAAA, deCRDX and deSPXA. The economic exposure becomes bearer and the redemption right does not: two tokens, one claim, two access regimes, and the second has no path to the obligor. RE-SITING: the corpus attaches this residue to Maple, where the measured permission level refutes it; it belongs here. Prohibition X19 (a restricted claim bridged via Xf into a representation with no destination-side Aw) does not literally fire because deRWA is a wrapper rather than a bridge, which is itself the finding: THE PROHIBITION IS DOMAIN-SPECIFIC WHERE THE HAZARD IS NOT.

nodes.label: F10 messages between chains are delivered by several independent adapters
nodes.text: messages between chains are delivered by several independent adapters and each pool chooses which of them it trusts and how many must agree
nodes.note: Xm is confirmed and materially richer than the symbol. Deployed on mainnet: Chainlink 0x39CF679E..7D955, Axelar 0x34e90423..a6484, Wormhole 0x4BE43040..706A7 and a second Wormhole adapter, aggregated behind MultiAdapter 0x35C837F0..073BE and Gateway 0x19a524D0..D3172. Each pool calls setAdapters to choose providers, a confirmation threshold setting the minimum number of adapters that must deliver a message before it is processed, and recovery adapters. RESIDUE INSIDE THE SYMBOL: Xm is a boolean, and here verification strength is A PARAMETER CHOSEN BY THE PARTY WHOSE ASSETS ARE AT RISK, so two pools on the same protocol can have materially different cross-domain security and carry the same symbol. L18 (explicit finality, domain binding, replay protection) is not separately evidenced and should be checked in stage 3.

nodes.label: F11 share tokens move between chains with the eligibility hook invoked on
nodes.text: share tokens move between chains with the eligibility hook invoked on both the outgoing and the incoming leg
nodes.note: Confirmed: limit token bridging, hook is invoked on outgoing and incoming cross-chain transfers. This means L26 (Aw plus Xf implies destination-enforced eligibility) is satisfied BY CONSTRUCTION here, which is the only clean discharge of L26 in this category and is worth stating positively. Core contracts sit at identical addresses across 11 networks (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Plume, BNB, Optimism, HyperEVM, Monad, Pharos, X Layer), a correction to the corpus's and the docs' own llms.txt figure of 9.

nodes.label: F12 one immutable contract holds administrative access over every other co
nodes.text: one immutable contract holds administrative access over every other contract in the protocol, and every escalation of privilege through it waits forty-eight hours
nodes.note: The protocol is controlled by the Root contract, an immutable smart contract that holds admin (ward) access on all other contracts, mainnet 0xdc9456e7e20f15029C8231Ec433a20F404b7235E, and all privilege escalation through Root goes through a 48-hour timelock. This is the STRONGEST control plane of the five and the decomposition must not treat it as equivalent to BUIDL's single EOA or to Maple's retroactively shortenable delay; L15 is discharged here in a way it is not for Ondo, USYC or BUIDL. RESIDUE INSIDE THE PAIR: rendering this as Up plus Tg loses the actual design, which is that the AUTHORITY contract cannot be upgraded but can rewrite the permissions on everything else after two days. Immutable-but-omnipotent is a distinct shape and neither symbol names it.

nodes.label: F13 two separate guardians hold different powers on separate multisignatur
nodes.text: two separate guardians hold different powers on separate multisignature wallets, and only one of them can pause anything
nodes.note: ProtocolGuardian 0xCEb7eD5d5B3bAD3088f6A1697738B60d829635c6 holds pause, upgrades and cross-chain powers, with every transaction verified by third-party signers from Cantina; OpsGuardian 0x055589229506Ee89645EF08ebE9B9a863486d0dE holds wiring and pool creation and has NO PAUSE AUTHORITY. Both at identical addresses on every network. Gp names the facility and cannot express that the power to halt and the power to configure are deliberately held by different parties, the same split the 06-yield lane recorded for Sky's grantors and revokers and for Huma's pauser and restarter.

nodes.label: F14 the global pause is deliberately partial: it halts all cross-chain mes
nodes.text: the global pause is deliberately partial: it halts all cross-chain messaging in both directions and leaves local deposits, redemptions and withdrawals running
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Verbatim: the global pause halts all cross-chain messaging, both inbound and outbound; local vault operations (deposit, redeem, withdraw) are not affected. Gp implies stopping the protocol; here the guardian can stop the nervous system while the limbs keep moving. That is arguably the right design, and the vocabulary cannot record THE SCOPE OF A PAUSE at all, so a pause that stops everything and a pause that stops messaging carry the same symbol.

nodes.label: F15 each strategist is given a merkle root encoding the exact set of calls
nodes.text: each strategist is given a merkle root encoding the exact set of calls they may make, verified per call by target contract, function selector and parameter values, and revised by replacing the root
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: the corpus does not record Au for Centrifuge at all, and the MerkleProofManager is delegated execution scope in the strongest sense the vocabulary contemplates, far more expressive than the symbol suggests. L17 (bounded scope, revocation, expiry, nonce or domain separation) is partly discharged: scope and revocation are explicit, expiry and replay separation are not evidenced. Related pool roles that Au does not reach: a hub manager can grant or revoke the hub manager role for OTHER addresses, so the top-level authority is self-propagating; a gateway manager can block outgoing messages for one pool on one destination, a pool-scoped circuit breaker; and OnOfframpManager runs a permissionless onramp against a relayer-gated offramp to pre-approved destinations.

nodes.label: F16 there is no seniority anywhere in the protocol: multiple share classes
nodes.text: there is no seniority anywhere in the protocol: multiple share classes exist, they can be named and permissioned differently, and nothing allocates a loss between them
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and a CORRECTION the corpus requires: Tr is REFUTED for V3 and DROPPED. The evidence is a code search over repo:centrifuge/protocol returning ZERO hits for waterfall, senior, junior and subordinat, and six hits for tranche, every one of them in the 2023 Code4rena audit document, a test-properties file, or a legacy env/spell/*.sol migration script, NONE IN src/ (GitHub code search, accessed 2026-08-04). The docs' junior/senior tranches phrasing describes a CONFIGURATION IDIOM: an issuer may create two share classes, whitelist them differently and price them differently. There is no loss-allocation logic, no seniority ordering, no overcollateralisation test, no interest-coverage test and no trigger that redirects anything. Subordination, where it exists in a Centrifuge pool, lives in the fund's offering documents and is expressed on chain only as the manager choosing to mark one share class down before another. The corpus's residue note about DROP and TIN describes V2 and Tinlake, not V3. CONSEQUENCE: with Tr removed, Sv becomes the ONLY symbol carrying loss allocation for this application, because the sole way a loss reaches a holder is a manager-set price.

nodes.label: F17 a defaulted underlying asset has no on-chain representation of any kin
nodes.text: a defaulted underlying asset has no on-chain representation of any kind: no delinquency state, no roll rate, no write-off flag and no impairment call exist in the protocol
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and the on-chain state is EMPTIER than the corpus implies. Holdings and Accounting carry valuations and journal entries; src/valuations contains exactly IdentityValuation.sol and OracleValuation.sol. A default appears only as a lower number in the next updateSharePrice call. Compare Maple, which at least has impairLoan and unrealizedLosses: Centrifuge V3 has strictly less servicing state than the corpus's phrasing, that Sv gestures at discretion but names no state, implies, because there is no state to gesture at.

nodes.label: F18 the holder must know who owes them the money, and here the protocol ow
nodes.text: the holder must know who owes them the money, and here the protocol owes them nothing: the obligor is an off-chain fund and Centrifuge is infrastructure
nodes.note: RESIDUE. For the flagship share class the issuer is Anemoy Capital SPC Limited, a British Virgin Islands segregated portfolio company regulated by the BVI Financial Services Commission; the protocol is a set of contracts with no claim against it. The entity details beyond BVI regulation (Anemoy Asset Management as investment manager, Janus Henderson as sub-investment manager) rest on web-search consensus and are marked UNCONFIRMED at a primary source. No element names an obligor. The structural point that distinguishes Centrifuge from the other four: the obligor is DIFFERENT PER SHARE CLASS on the same protocol, since five issuers use it, so a decomposition of the protocol is not a decomposition of any holder's claim, and the vocabulary has no way to mark that separation.

nodes.label: F19 the holder must know whether the chain is the register, and here the t
nodes.text: the holder must know whether the chain is the register, and here the token is prima facie evidence of ownership under BVI law in the same way a share certificate would be
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and the third of three distinct legal devices in this category. Prima facie evidence is precisely NOT the register: a share certificate is rebuttable evidence of an entry in a book kept elsewhere. So all three fund-wrapped instruments place the chain BELOW an off-chain register, by three different routes, BUIDL through a US transfer agent's books and records, USYC through a fund administrator's share registry and an explicit digital-twin metaphor, and JTRSY through the BVI law of share certificates. The vocabulary has ONE WORD, none, for three distinct legal relationships, AND THE DIFFERENCES DETERMINE WHAT HAPPENS WHEN THE CHAIN AND THE BOOK DISAGREE: under BUIDL's device the book simply wins and the transfer is not a redemption; under USYC's the book is updated to follow; under Anemoy's the holder must go to a BVI court and rebut.

nodes.label: F20 the holder must know whether their claim survives the issuer's insolve
nodes.text: the holder must know whether their claim survives the issuer's insolvency, and here a bankruptcy-remote structure is asserted by the issuer and no security trustee is named anywhere
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Anemoy's own page states the fund is a registered and regulated fund approved by the BVI Financial Services Commission with a bankruptcy remote SPV structure. CORRECTION: the corpus's security trustee holding the assets for tokenholders' benefit is NOT EVIDENCED and is marked UNKNOWN; no security trustee is named in anything fetched and no offering document is public. What IS nameable in fact and not in vocabulary is the SPC form itself: a segregated portfolio company statutorily ring-fences each portfolio's assets from the others' liabilities, which is a legal firewall between claim classes that looks superficially like Im (isolated market) but is created by BVI statute rather than by contract deployment and survives insolvency, which Im does not claim to do. Im is NOT emitted for that reason: it would attribute to a deployment a property that only a statute confers.

nodes.label: F21 the holder must know what the reserve holds and who custodies it, and
nodes.text: the holder must know what the reserve holds and who custodies it, and here the fund discloses the roles and names none of the parties
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The fund states that it works with an independent prime broker, custodian, tokenization and issuance, and fund admin service providers. UNKNOWN: the names of the administrator, custodian, prime broker and auditor; the page discloses roles WITHOUT ENTITIES. Nothing on chain records what the portfolio holds either: Holdings and Accounting carry valuations, not instruments, and there is no reserve report of any kind. At is not emitted (see F4), so on this construction the protocol asserts a price and attests nothing.

nodes.label: F22 the holder must know who may change what the money is invested in, and
nodes.text: the holder must know who may change what the money is invested in, and here nothing on chain records who selected an asset or on what criteria
nodes.note: RESIDUE, confirmed unnameable, and the boundary must be stated because Centrifuge is the case that most tempts a forced fit. The MerkleProofManager emitted at F15 constrains WHAT CALLS A STRATEGIST MAY MAKE, which is an execution-scope constraint, not a credit criterion; Au therefore bounds the mechanics of allocation while saying nothing about its merits. The vocabulary has no way to distinguish a pool whose assets were chosen by a rated manager from one whose assets were chosen arbitrarily. Fifth of five products in this category with unconstrained, invisible investment discretion, and the fifth independent confirmation in this lane of the delegated allocation mandate the 06-yield and 03-CDP lanes identified as a missing level above the element.

nodes.label: Circle USYC (Hashnote)
F1 an investor subscribes USDC and receives a token equal in number to th
nodes.text: an investor subscribes USDC and receives a token equal in number to the shares they hold in a Cayman Islands mutual fund
nodes.note: Hashnote mints an amount of USYC tokens equivalent to the number of shares the investor has in the fund, and price equals net asset value divided by supply. The reconciliation is measurable: cross-chain token supply about 2,651.3M against the oracle's share count 2,654,890,748.20, agreeing to 0.13 per cent, so essentially the whole fund is tokenised. The corpus marker stands: Sh elsewhere in this vocabulary means a claim on a pool the contract can enumerate, and this contract can enumerate nothing.

nodes.label: F2 the claim accrues in the price rather than in the balance, so a holder
nodes.text: the claim accrues in the price rather than in the balance, so a holder who does nothing holds the same number of tokens worth more each day
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: the corpus omits Ix for USYC and it is a clean instance. Verified by reading the oracle and the balances separately: round 483 answer 1.133066960425761961 while holder balances are static. Ix is APPROXIMATE in one respect worth recording, that the index is not computed by the protocol from its own state but posted by the issuer (F3).

nodes.label: F3 the price is struck once per business day off-chain from a prime broke
nodes.text: the price is struck once per business day off-chain from a prime brokerage account and published on-chain at about nine in the morning eastern time through a Chainlink-interface aggregator
nodes.note: Ex is confirmed twice over for USYC, once for price and once for sanctions (F8), and the price oracle is provably the one the redemption path uses because Teller.oracle() returns exactly 0x74f2199AEb743f68f05943e5715A33EaF2b61f53 (18 decimals, round 483, updatedAt 1785846203). At is SCOPED: there is a daily NAV publication with a named administrator (NAV Consulting) and a named auditor (Cohen and Company), so a named attester exists, but there is NO reserve attestation of any kind, and the vocabulary conflates the two. Circle's docs claim the token price AND FUND HOLDINGS are published through an onchain oracle; latestRoundData returns only a price and the richest API payload carries only principal, interest, balance, price, supply and fee, with no composition at all. Sv is added as a DEPARTURE: the issuer determines the price, may delay it for operational or technical reasons, and decides discretionarily how much instant liquidity exists on a given day. Two live aggregators exist and the docs disagree on which is canonical (0x4c48bcb2160F8e0aDbf9D4F3B034f1e36d1f8b3e, 8 decimals, round 773, answer 1.13281096, a different value on a different schedule).

nodes.label: F4 a subscription arriving after two in the afternoon eastern time is pri
nodes.text: a subscription arriving after two in the afternoon eastern time is priced at a forecast of the next price report rather than at any observed value
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Neither Ex (an observed external datum) nor Ix (mechanical accrual) names an issuer-computed PROJECTION of a value not yet determined, with the issuer bearing or capturing the difference. Distinct from Sv, which names discretion over a determination that has been made.

nodes.label: F5 redemptions execute at a different price from subscriptions, with a ti
nodes.text: redemptions execute at a different price from subscriptions, with a time-varying spread between the two legs
nodes.note: RESIDUE. A two-price mechanism on the same instrument at the same instant. The vocabulary treats an instrument as having a price; this one has two, and which one applies depends on the direction the holder is travelling.

nodes.label: F6 a holder may burn the token at the smart contract teller and be paid U
nodes.text: a holder may burn the token at the smart contract teller and be paid USDC at the latest reported price, at any hour of any day
nodes.note: APPROXIMATE, and the conditionality is not cosmetic. The teller ABI is minimal, deposit(uint256,address) and redeem(uint256,address,address), and mainnet teller 0xeE35F963BFC71b51eC95147f26c030D674ea30e6 has asset() = USDC. Rd asserts a right; F7 and F8 record why this one is discretionary in substance. Subscription funds arriving after 2 PM EST mint on the next business day.

nodes.label: F7 no reserve stands behind that promise: the teller holds no USDC of its
nodes.text: no reserve stands behind that promise: the teller holds no USDC of its own, liquidity is pushed in by an operator at transaction time, and a holder needing more than the day's posted amount is told to contact the issuer
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and it is a measurement, not an inference: the mainnet teller's USDC balance is 0.0 and the BSC cross-chain teller's is 0.0, and an eth_getLogs scan for USDC Transfer into the mainnet teller over the most recent 4,000 blocks returned zero events (JSON-RPC ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com and bsc-rpc.publicnode.com, accessed 2026-08-04). Overflow is handled by an email address, not by a queue, so Wq is correctly absent and its absence must NOT be read as evidence of unconditional liquidity. UNKNOWN: the numeric cap; /api/liquidity and /api/teller both return 404 and no existing endpoint carries a capacity field. The fallback is NOT documented as T+1 and must not be asserted as such.

nodes.label: F8 unconditional instant convertibility exists but must be bought: it is
nodes.text: unconditional instant convertibility exists but must be bought: it is a separately priced per-client tier carrying additional fees
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The Private Liquidity Teller allows a client up to 100 per cent instant liquidity into USDC at all times, and additional fees apply. If 100 per cent instant liquidity must be purchased, the default teller manifestly does not provide it. The vocabulary treats redemption as a uniform property of an instrument; USYC's is STRATIFIED BY CONTRACT, and two holders of the same token have different rights. This is also the only publicly visible glimpse of bilateral variation in an otherwise private document set.

nodes.label: F9 only wallets an off-chain administrator has approved may hold, subscri
nodes.text: only wallets an off-chain administrator has approved may hold, subscribe or redeem, and the check runs in a contract the token itself points at
nodes.note: The gate is provably wired: authority() on the token 0x136471a34f6ef19fE571EFFC1CA711fdb8E49f2b returns 0x902D906b8d988092213bE799B18Bd2cbd64F808C, exactly the Entitlements contract named in the docs. Entitlements are the gatekeepers to most of the functionality of USYC. The determination is human and off-chain: the fund administrator performs KYC and AML, then a screening provider whitelists the wallet. Non-US persons only, minimum US$100,000, Regulation S.

nodes.label: F10 eligibility is additionally revoked, continuously and by a third party
nodes.text: eligibility is additionally revoked, continuously and by a third party, through a live sanctions oracle queried on every transfer
nodes.note: APPROXIMATE and the reason matters: Aw is INSUFFICIENT alone. The gate is a conjunction of two things with different temporal character, a static-ish allowlist bit set once at onboarding, and a dynamic negative check against a Chainalysis oracle that can invalidate a previously-valid wallet with no action by Circle, Hashnote or the holder. Ex is emitted here for the oracle, which is the second confirmed instance of Ex in this application. The residue is the SHAPE: an external oracle acting as a revocation channel, and a live protocol dependency on one firm's data availability and correctness.

nodes.label: F11 the issuer can halt all transactions in the token and can destroy a na
nodes.text: the issuer can halt all transactions in the token and can destroy a named holder's balance, but no evidence exists that it can reassign one
nodes.note: CANDIDATE-REGISTER (Fz). The Entitlements contract can freeze all transactions involving USYC and Hashnote has the ability to prevent any transaction from being completed; live paused() is false. Selector extraction from the deployed implementations shows mint(address,uint256), burn(uint256) and burn(address,uint256), the last being an administrative burn of another party's balance. A targeted search for forceTransfer, seize, clawback, destroyBlackFunds, freeze(address) and blacklist(address) found none, so the Fz gloss overstates USYC by one power (forced transfer) and understates it by another (targeted destruction). Selector extraction is strong evidence of presence and weaker evidence of absence. Gp is emitted for pause()/unpause() on Entitlements.

nodes.label: F12 the code of every core contract can be replaced by whoever owns its im
nodes.text: the code of every core contract can be replaced by whoever owns its implementation, and three different parties own the four of them
nodes.note: All four core contracts are EIP-1967 proxies with UUPS-style upgradeTo and upgradeToAndCall; the admin slot is empty and the implementation slot populated on each, so upgrade authority sits with each implementation's owner(). Token impl owner 0x13ff8cAb..82dD6, Teller impl owner 0x8B1A2015..a3a55B, Entitlements impl owner 0x8fb098d6..5d2FC0, Oracle impl owner 0x1De107Dc..B19E98. Three distinct owners, so the control plane is segmented rather than a single key. UNKNOWN whether any owner is a multisig; owner bytecode was not fetched, so this must not be reported as safer than BUIDL, only as different. No timelock is evidenced anywhere, so L15 (Up implies Tg or a bounded emergency process) is NOT discharged.

nodes.label: F13 the same claim is issued natively on three chains with dedicated cross
nodes.text: the same claim is issued natively on three chains with dedicated cross-chain subscribe and redeem paths, and ninety-seven per cent of it lives on the chain of the one venue that accepts it as margin
nodes.note: DEPARTURE, and it REVERSES a corpus attribution. The corpus records Xf and Xm for BUIDL and neither for USYC, and identicalClaimedByLane records the two applications as identical. Measured supplies on 2026-08-04: Ethereum 77,375,020.09, BNB Chain 2,573,937,729.19, Solana 113.69. Cross-chain tellers are deployed on Ethereum (0x5dbeCcECEbCdC2ce3258f6E638373d2923560c7d) and BSC (0xf38979E0..3D08). QUALIFICATION: issuance is NATIVE per chain, so Xf here means multi-domain native issuance with a cross-domain subscribe and redeem path, not lock-and-mint bridging. Xm is deliberately NOT emitted: every ABI probe of the cross-chain teller (owner, token, messenger, tokenMessenger, endpoint, lzEndpoint) reverted against 7,920 bytes of unverified bytecode and no document names a protocol, so the messaging layer is UNKNOWN and must not be asserted in either direction. On the evidence USYC has BETTER cross-domain support than BUIDL, which is the reverse of what the corpus records, and the two decompositions differ by at least four symbols before any of this is considered.

nodes.label: F14 the token's primary use is not investment but margin: it sits immobili
nodes.text: the token's primary use is not investment but margin: it sits immobilised with a tri-party custodian, pledged against derivatives positions at an exchange, while continuing to accrue
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and it is the dominant actual use rather than a side use: Circle's own 10-K says USYC is intended primarily for use as collateral in digital asset markets (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1876042/000187604226000062/crcl-20251231.htm, accessed 2026-08-04). Held through Binance Banking Triparty or with Ceffu. There is no symbol for pledged-but-yielding collateral held by a third-party custodian, and this also EXPLAINS F13's concentration: the distribution of the supply across chains is a function of one exchange's collateral policy, which is itself a concentration risk with no name.

nodes.label: F15 a ten per cent performance fee on yield plus four and three basis poin
nodes.text: a ten per cent performance fee on yield plus four and three basis points on subscription and redemption are taken by the manager off the net asset value
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Fd (surplus and fee distribution) was considered and REJECTED rather than approximated: Fd names a protocol distributing realised surplus to claim classes it can enumerate, and this is a fee charged off an off-chain net asset value by an off-chain manager, invisible to every contract. Measured effect, live: gross yield 3.5199632342282894 per cent against net 3.1679669108054607 per cent.

nodes.label: F16 the holder must know who owes them the money, and here the fund owes i
nodes.text: the holder must know who owes them the money, and here the fund owes it while a different company in a different jurisdiction is the party they deal with, and three primary sources disagree about which of the two is the issuer
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The economic obligor is Hashnote International Short Duration Yield Fund Ltd., a CIMA-licensed Cayman exempted mutual fund; Circle International Bermuda Limited is the token administrator responsible for the management of USYC on behalf of the fund. The unresolved inconsistency must be flagged and not resolved: the USYC docs, Circle's developer docs and the 10-K regulatory section all say CIBL issues USYC, while 10-K Note 3 says the fund is the issuer of USYC and the press-release disclaimer calls CIBL merely token administrator. Recourse against Circle is nil and stated as such: the Company provides no guarantees and has no other financial obligations to each of the funds, and its maximum exposure to loss is limited to its insignificant investment and its obligations to perform services as the manager. Circle acquired the MANAGER (Hashnote Holdings LLC, about $100.1m, January 2025), not the fund. No element names an obligor, and none names the issuer-agency split in which the entity a holder deals with is not the entity that owes them.

nodes.label: F17 the holder must know whether the chain is the register, and here the t
nodes.text: the holder must know whether the chain is the register, and here the token is explicitly a digital twin of a transfer agent's share register that the administrator moves afterwards to match
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and the DIRECTION OF THE SENTENCE is the finding. Three quotes settle it: ownership in the fund is represented as shares at the Transfer Agent, and whose digital twins are represented onchain; the fund administrator moves shares in the share registry TO REFLECT movements in the USYC token; the client's redemption of the USYC token WILL BE REFLECTED IN the fund registry by our fund administrator. A twin is by construction a copy of something that exists elsewhere, so the register is legally primary; but the registry moves to reflect the token, so the token is operationally primary in ordering. USYC is on-chain-primary in sequence and off-chain-primary in legal effect. A formalisation that treats the token as the ledger of record misstates what a holder owns; one that treats it as a mere mirror misstates where transactions sequence. Both readings are wrong alone and the vocabulary can express neither, nor the fund administrator's role as the reconciling party between them. This is one of three distinct legal devices used to place the chain below a book in this category; compare BUIDL (a US transfer agent's books and records) and Centrifuge JTRSY (prima facie evidence under BVI law).

nodes.label: F18 the holder must know whether their claim survives the issuer's insolve
nodes.text: the holder must know whether their claim survives the issuer's insolvency, and here they hold an unsecured equity interest with no security agreement, no collateral agent and no perfection step of any kind
nodes.note: RESIDUE. There is no security interest to perfect: USYC is a fund share, not a secured note, and unlike Ondo no collateral agent, control agreement or first-priority claim is asserted anywhere. What IS established is segregation from Circle's balance sheet, unusually well evidenced: the fund is an unconsolidated variable interest entity in Circle's own 10-K, so a Circle insolvency does not reach the fund, and symmetrically holders have no recourse to Circle. Creditor ranking is structural and point-in-time: the fund reported total assets $1,537,818 thousand and total liabilities of nil at 2025-12-31, so at that date nothing ranked ahead of tokenholders; the fund is now about $3.0B and no updated liability figure exists. The instrument that actually creates the claim is the offering memorandum, which is NOT OBTAINABLE, so gating, suspension, side letters and wind-down are all UNKNOWN and must not be asserted. An offer is only made to eligible investors through the fund's offering documents, and those documents are private by construction.

nodes.label: F19 the holder must know what the reserve holds and who holds it, and here
nodes.text: the holder must know what the reserve holds and who holds it, and here the assets sit at a prime broker in repo positions whose counterparties are never named and whose composition is never published
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Confirmed: Hashnote transfers the investor's funds to its prime brokerage to invest into T-bills and enter repo and reverse-repo agreements; Circle's docs weight it toward repo, primarily reverse repurchase agreements backed by U.S. government securities. Prime broker Marex, bank Customers Bank, auditor Cohen and Company, administrator NAV Consulting, KYC NAV Consulting and LMO Consulting, MPC wallets Fireblocks. There is NO separate custodian: assets are protected through segregated custodial accounts AT OUR PRIME BROKER, which is a broker, and the phrase qualified custodian appears in no USYC or Circle source fetched, so the paper must not describe USYC as employing qualified custody. Repo counterparty exposure is UNKNOWN, no concentration limit is published, and no holdings breakdown exists in any retrievable format. NEGATIVE RESULT worth recording: the strings prime broker and Marex do not appear anywhere in Circle's FY2025 10-K, so the single largest source of risk in the instrument is disclosed only in product documentation and never in the public-company filing.

nodes.label: F20 the holder must know who may change what the money is invested in, and
nodes.text: the holder must know who may change what the money is invested in, and here the manager sets the mix between bills and repo with no published mandate, band or limit
nodes.note: RESIDUE, applying the same boundary used across this lane: Sv (emitted at F3) names discretion over a DETERMINATION, and nothing names discretion over an ALLOCATION. The published policy is one adverb, primarily, attached to reverse repo. This is the fourth of five products in this category whose investment discretion is unconstrained and invisible, and it converges with the delegated allocation mandate that the 06-yield and 03-CDP lanes independently identified as a missing level above the element.

nodes.label: Maple Finance (syrupUSDC / institutional pools)
F1 a lender deposits a stablecoin into a shared pool and receives a vault
nodes.text: a lender deposits a stablecoin into a shared pool and receives a vault share whose redemption value rises as borrowers repay
nodes.note: Each pool inherits the ERC-4626 standard, which informs how the LP tokens accrue value from borrower repayments. Measured live on 2026-08-04 at the syrupUSDC pool 0x80ac24aA929eaF5013f6436cdA2a7ba190f5Cc0b: totalSupply 932,261,251.64, totalAssets 1,097,084,773.24, convertToAssets(1e6) = 1,176,799, unrealizedLosses 0. Ix was considered and not emitted: the share price rises because totalAssets rises, and there is no global index object separate from the pool's own accounting. L2 (Pl implies a claim form plus exit liquidity) is discharged by Sh plus Wq at F9.

nodes.label: F2 the pooled deposits are lent to named institutional borrowers as dated
nodes.text: the pooled deposits are lent to named institutional borrowers as dated loan contracts, on terms agreed off chain, with both fixed-term and open-term forms in use
nodes.note: Pool to PoolManager to LoanManagers attached as strategies to MapleLoan instances. Ft SHARPENED from the corpus marker: Maple runs both fixed-term and open-term loan managers, so the maturity of the asset is a choice per strategy rather than a fixed property of the protocol. The corpus marker still stands on the other side: the LENDER's claim is perpetual and open-ended, so Ft describes only the asset side and the maturity mismatch between the two is the actual mechanism and is unnamed.

nodes.label: F3 borrowers post collateral into the loan contract itself, and the proto
nodes.text: borrowers post collateral into the loan contract itself, and the protocol reports the ratio of collateral to loans as a live figure
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: the corpus records Ct as DERIVED and that is wrong; it is real and on-chain. Maple's own API on 2026-08-04 returns collateralValue $1,921,120,739.50 against loansValue $1,300,514,362.23, a collateralRatio of 147.72 per cent (https://api.maple.finance/v2/graphql, accessed 2026-08-04). CORRECTION to the corpus residue: the claim that collateral is held in off-chain qualified custody under a tri-party control agreement is REFUTED at the protocol layer; no primary source names BitGo, Anchorage, Copper or any control agreement, and the documented default procedure repossesses collateral on chain before liquidating it. The accurate statement is a SPLIT: custody and accounting of collateral are on-chain, and price monitoring and the act of selling are off-chain. Uc is NOT emitted and is refuted on the facts: at 147.72 per cent this is over-collateralised secured lending, while the risk remains entirely in the underwriting judgement, which no symbol reaches.

nodes.label: F4 the solvency test itself runs off chain: an operations team watches th
nodes.text: the solvency test itself runs off chain: an operations team watches three price feeds around the clock, gives a borrower twenty-four hours to top up, and then sells the collateral through over-the-counter desks under the loan agreement
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and Li is genuinely ABSENT rather than approximate: there is no liquidator contract, no auction, no keeper and no liquidation bonus anywhere in the repositories or the docs. Verbatim: Maple liquidates their collateral as part of the legal agreement with the borrower, with CEXs or DEXs as a fallback. The sharpened residue is that THE PROTOCOL CAN SEIZE BUT CANNOT SELL, and the vocabulary has no way to record a negative, no symbol meaning solvency is accounted on-chain and enforced off-chain. L1d is discharged by Sl at F6 and not by Li.

nodes.label: F5 on default the pool delegate chooses whether to repossess at all, and
nodes.text: on default the pool delegate chooses whether to repossess at all, and the same human judgement decides when a loan is impaired
nodes.note: CANDIDATE-REGISTER (Sv), and this is its intended sense: the delegate has the OPTION to repossess the loan after a grace period. Sv covers the determination. The corpus marker stands and is sharpened at F22: the delegate also SELECTS COUNTERPARTIES and SIZES EXPOSURE, which is an allocation act, and Sv does not reach it.

nodes.label: F6 any loss remaining after collateral and cover are exhausted is a strai
nodes.text: any loss remaining after collateral and cover are exhausted is a straight reduction in the pool's assets, borne pro rata by every remaining lender
nodes.note: DEPARTURE, and the most consequential omission in the corpus decomposition. Remaining losses are represented to LPs as a decrease in totalAssets, which is exactly what Sl names. With Bs removed (F8), Sl becomes the ONLY loss-absorption mechanism Maple has, and law L1d (Pl implies one of Li, Ad, Sl, Bs) is then satisfied by Sl alone. This very plausibly explains the corpus's recorded satisfiesRequirementsAndWarrants: false, which would have been a decomposition artefact rather than a fact about Maple.

nodes.label: F7 a manager may declare a paper loss that immediately reduces what an ex
nodes.text: a manager may declare a paper loss that immediately reduces what an exiting lender receives, may reverse it, and the protocol states the purpose is to incentivise current lenders to remain
nodes.note: RESIDUE. impairLoan writes unrealizedLosses, which is factored into the pool's value for withdrawals, incentivizing current Liquidity Providers to remain in the Pool. Neither Sv (discretion) nor Sl (loss allocation) names A REVERSIBLE PROVISIONAL LOSS USED AS AN EXIT DETERRENT. Second residue in the same object: the override is ASYMMETRIC between two discretionary authorities, since a Governor impairment cannot be reversed by the delegate while a delegate impairment can be reversed by the Governor. The vocabulary treats authority as a set, not a lattice, which is the same party-sort gap the 07-bridges lane recorded in a different dress.

nodes.label: F8 the first-loss module exists in the code and is deliberately empty, an
nodes.text: the first-loss module exists in the code and is deliberately empty, and the staked governance token was never slashable and no longer earns anything
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and Bs is REFUTED twice over, so it is DROPPED from the corpus construction. The docs' own heading reads First-Loss Capital (Unused), noting the Pool Delegate Cover is unused due to most pools being managed by Maple Direct. Separately, staking rewards were sunset with MIP-019, the interface supports only unstaking, and stSYRUP can be unstaked at any time without limits or penalties (https://docs.maple.finance/maple-for-token-holders/syrup-tokenomics/staking.md, accessed 2026-08-04). Maple currently has no slashable first-loss capital of any kind. The vocabulary cannot distinguish a protocol that has a backstop from one that has a backstop CONTRACT that is deliberately empty, and the difference is the whole of the lender's protection.

nodes.label: F9 an exiting lender joins a first-in first-out queue served as liquidity
nodes.text: an exiting lender joins a first-in first-out queue served as liquidity appears, normally within a day and contractually within thirty
nodes.note: Wq is exact here. WithdrawalManager queue variant 0x1bc47a0dd0fdab96e9ef982fdf1f34dc6207cfe3 for syrupUSDC; assets are pushed to the lender without a second transaction, and a pending request can be reduced or cancelled with the shares returned. Ep is deliberately NOT emitted and the corpus's silence is correct: the older cyclical withdrawal manager was window-based, and the current syrup pools use the queue. This is the exact mirror image of Centrifuge, where Ep carries the mechanism and Wq is at best a loose description, and a decomposition that gives both symbols to both protocols loses the distinction.

nodes.label: F10 the instant exit is not a protocol facility at all: a lender who will
nodes.text: the instant exit is not a protocol facility at all: a lender who will not wait sells the share token into third-party automated market makers the protocol does not control
nodes.note: RESIDUE. As an alternative to withdrawals, users can swap syrupUSDC via Uniswap or Balancer, which enables instant liquidity for users that do not want to wait. Wq names the queue; nothing names THE REDEMPTION RIGHT IS SLOW AND THE REAL EXIT IS A THIRD-PARTY MARKET, and nothing marks an element as inherited from a dependency. The same defect was recorded independently in the 06-yield lane for Huma and Spark.

nodes.label: F11 who may lend is decided by matching a lender's bitmap of off-chain cri
nodes.text: who may lend is decided by matching a lender's bitmap of off-chain criteria against the pool's required bitmap, at four configurable strictness levels, and the check follows the share token on transfer
nodes.note: Aw is present but structurally far richer than a bit. Source constants PRIVATE 0, FUNCTION_LEVEL 1, POOL_LEVEL 2, PUBLIC 3, verified at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maple-labs/pool-permission-manager/main/contracts/MaplePoolPermissionManager.sol (accessed 2026-08-04); levels 1 and 2 evaluate (poolBitmap AND lenderBitmaps[lender]) == poolBitmap, where each bit represents a criterion a lender must meet off chain. Transfer-time enforcement is documented, so L16 is discharged. MEASURED CORRECTION to the corpus: syrupUSDC is NOT permissionless. PoolPermissionManager.permissionLevels(0x7ad5ffa5fdf509e30186f4609c2f6269f4b6158f) returns 1, FUNCTION_LEVEL. It follows that the corpus's laundering residue, a wrapper that turns a permissioned claim into a permissionless one, DOES NOT DESCRIBE MAPLE; Maple's own FAQ also states that new unique pools were established for syrupUSDC to ensure proceeds and risks are segmented from existing pools, so the syrup pools and the institutional pools are not the same loan book. That residue belongs to Centrifuge's deRWA tokens and is recorded there.

nodes.label: F12 the permission check returns true by default: if a pool's criteria bit
nodes.text: the permission check returns true by default: if a pool's criteria bitmap was never set, everyone passes, and the protocol documents this as intentional
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The hasPermission function will always return true if the bitmaps are not set. This is by design. Aw has no notion of a gate's DEFAULT, let alone a permissive one. A gate that fails open and a gate that fails closed are different security objects and carry the same symbol.

nodes.label: F13 a pool may be made permissionless once and can never be made permissio
nodes.text: a pool may be made permissionless once and can never be made permissioned again
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Once a lending pool is set to public, it cannot be changed back to permissioned, recorded as invariant D. This is an irreversible transition in the ACCESS REGIME OVER TIME, a property of the gate's history rather than its state, and Aw is a state predicate that cannot carry it.

nodes.label: F14 fees are split between the pool delegate and the protocol on chain, an
nodes.text: fees are split between the pool delegate and the protocol on chain, and a quarter of protocol revenue is directed to buying back the governance token
nodes.note: CANDIDATE-REGISTER (Fd), confirmed, with a measurement that qualifies it: delegateManagementFeeRate() on the syrupUSDC PoolManager is 0, so the split the corpus cites as a real on-chain flow is currently zero on the flagship pool. DEPARTURE in the same area: Em is REFUTED and DROPPED. Both protocol-funded emission channels are closed, staking rewards sunset by MIP-019 and the Drips lender programme phased out, verified on chain at syrupDrip 0x509712F368255E92410893Ba2E488f40f7E986EA whose deadline() is 1771416000, that is 2026-02-18T15:00:00Z, five and a half months before the access date. Surviving lender incentives are distributed via Merkl and funded by ECOSYSTEM PARTNERS, which is precisely what protocol-funded emissions are not. Also on default: all liquidated collateral and cover first goes towards recovering fees owed to the protocol, a genuine priority ordering over recovery proceeds, Tr-shaped but at the fee layer over a pool that has no tranches, and that ordering is residue.

nodes.label: F15 the protocol's contracts can be upgraded, only to implementations the
nodes.text: the protocol's contracts can be upgraded, only to implementations the governance has approved, after a scheduled delay, and a separate security administrator can pause every function immediately
nodes.note: PoolManager.upgrade(), LoanManager.upgrade() and WithdrawalManager.upgrade() route through MapleGlobals.scheduleCall() with a documented two-week wait; the Governor is GovernorTimelock 0x2eFFf88747EB5a3FF00d4d8d0f0800E306C0426b managed by a multisig with schedule, delay and execution window; factories are allowlisted in Globals so protocol contracts can verify on-chain that contracts have been vetted. L15 (Up implies Tg or a bounded emergency process) is discharged, subject to F16.

nodes.label: F16 the delay protecting those upgrades is set by the same authority the d
nodes.text: the delay protecting those upgrades is set by the same authority the delay is meant to restrain, can be changed at any time, and the change applies retroactively to calls already scheduled
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and arguably a defect the vocabulary should be able to name. Verbatim: timelock parameters are set by the Governor and can be changed at any time, having a retroactive effect, and the docs give the worked example in which a pending scheduled call becomes immediately executable once the Governor shortens the delay. Tg asserts delayed execution; it cannot express A DELAY THE DELAYED PARTY CONTROLS, so the protection is nominal and the symbol reads as though it were not. Compare Centrifuge, whose 48-hour timelock sits under an immutable Root, and BUIDL, which has an EOA: three protocols carry or lack the same symbol and the control planes are not comparable.

nodes.label: F17 the share token exists on several other chains, moved under Chainlink'
nodes.text: the share token exists on several other chains, moved under Chainlink's cross-chain messaging with a documented path for recovering failed messages
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: the corpus records neither symbol and both are supported. syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT are available on Solana, Arbitrum, Base, Plasma and others through a CCIP-based crosschain receiver developed in partnership with Chainlink, with failed-message retry and recovery; a SyrupOftAdapter also exists for the SYRUP token. L26 (Aw plus Xf implies destination-enforced eligibility) is NOT evidenced here: nothing fetched states that the destination chains re-run the bitmap check, and the syrup pools are FUNCTION_LEVEL gated on Ethereum. Flag for stage 3 rather than assert.

nodes.label: F18 the holder must know who owes them the money, and here the claim runs
nodes.text: the holder must know who owes them the money, and here the claim runs to a pool contract that holds loan contracts funded to named institutions under bilateral agreements whose governing law and recourse are not published
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The obligor chain is two steps and only the first is on chain. A MapleLoan is the contract that represents the agreement between a Lender and a Borrower, while the enforceable obligation lives in a document the protocol cannot read; Maple positions itself as a technology services provider and states that MAPLE IS NOT A LENDER. CORRECTION: the corpus asserts NY or English law; no governing law is evidenced anywhere and no agreement template is published, so it is UNKNOWN and must not be asserted. No element names an obligor, and none names the fact that a default is resolved by lawyers rather than by code.

nodes.label: F19 the holder must know whether the chain is the register, and here it is
nodes.text: the holder must know whether the chain is the register, and here it is: the pool contract is the authoritative ledger of the lender's claim, and Maple is the only one of the five whose investor register is on chain
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and the contrast is the value. Three of the five products place the chain BELOW an off-chain book by three different legal devices; Maple does not, because the lender's claim is created by the ERC-4626 contract and by nothing else, with no transfer agent, no share registry and no certificate. The vocabulary cannot state either side of that difference: it has no symbol meaning the chain IS the register and none meaning it is a mirror, so a decomposition of Maple and a decomposition of BUIDL are silent on the single question that most determines what each holder owns. The mirror relation reappears one level down, since the loan ASSET is a document the protocol cannot read (F18).

nodes.label: F20 the holder must know whether their claim is perfected against the borr
nodes.text: the holder must know whether their claim is perfected against the borrower's estate, and here no security trustee, control agreement or perfection step is evidenced anywhere, only possession of collateral by a contract
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The loan contract holds the collateral and can repossess it, which is possession, not perfection; whether that possession is recognised against a borrower's insolvency estate in the borrower's jurisdiction is undetermined and no document addresses it. No security agent is named, no financing statement is mentioned, and the master loan agreement that would settle it is not published. Of the five products in this category exactly one asserts a perfected security interest, and it is not this one.

nodes.label: F21 the holder must know what backs the claim and who holds it, and here t
nodes.text: the holder must know what backs the claim and who holds it, and here the answer is unusually good: collateral is custodied by the loan contracts on chain and the ratio is published, while the disposal of it is off chain
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and it is the category's positive control. Custody is on-chain in the loan contracts, so unlike the four fund products there is no custodian whose failure is the dominant tail risk. What remains unnameable is the composition of the loan book itself, since the identity, jurisdiction and financials of the borrowers are not on chain, and Maple publishes its own figures rather than an attested reserve report. At is NOT emitted: the API is self-published by the protocol with no independent attester, no assurance level and no recourse, so L27 could not be discharged. Measured 2026-08-04: assets $80.9M plus loans $1,544.2M plus collateral $1,900.3M, that is $3.525B by the docs' own AUM formula, against loansValue $1.3005B; these measure different things and the paper must say which.

nodes.label: F22 the holder must know who may change what the money is lent against, an
nodes.text: the holder must know who may change what the money is lent against, and here one delegate selects the counterparties, sets the rate and the size, and no concentration limit is enforced on chain
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and the sharpest instance in this category of the cross-lane finding. Interest is determined by the loan terms set by Maple's credit underwriting and risk management, and the borrower's ability to meet margin calls is checked pre-issuance and monitored on an ongoing basis; nothing on chain represents diligence, financials or a covenant package. UNKNOWN, leaning policy-only: no per-borrower concentration parameter exists in PoolManager, Globals or the docs; liquidityCap() is 2,500,000,000 on syrupUSDC and caps the POOL, not exposure to any one borrower. The vocabulary offers a symbol for the balance-sheet shape (Ct, F3) and none for the judgement, and here the balance sheet says secured lending while the risk is entirely in the judgement. This is the 06-yield and 03-CDP delegated allocation mandate again, with the bounded quantity being credit exposure: named agent yes, domain whitelist yes, magnitude cap only at the pool level, rate-of-change limit none, revocation via the Governor.

nodes.label: Ondo Finance (USDY + OUSG + Global Markets)
F1 a subscriber's dollars buy a token that evidences the issuer's debt to
nodes.text: a subscriber's dollars buy a token that evidences the issuer's debt to the subscriber as a lender, not a proportional interest in any pool
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and a DEPARTURE from the corpus, which emits Sh for the whole application. The SPV's purpose clause limits it to borrowing funds from prospective lenders and issuing USDY tokens to evidence the LLC's debt obligations to those lenders; Ondo calls holders lenders. A creditor claim of principal plus accrued interest is not a pro-rata slice of an enumerable pool, and no element in the 58 names a debt claim as such. SCOPE: Sh is retained in the construction for OUSG (F5) and for the rUSDY wrapper's internal share accounting only. Applying Sh to USDY conflates a creditor with an equity holder, which is precisely the distinction the security agreement exists to preserve.

nodes.label: F2 the USDY redemption price rises every day by a rate that compounds det
nodes.text: the USDY redemption price rises every day by a rate that compounds deterministically on-chain between administrative rate changes
nodes.note: The RWADynamicOracle is configured with a series of ranges, each with a start time, an end time and a daily interest rate that compounds across the range; the price therefore accrues mechanically between updates. Live getPrice() = 1.14179424 on 2026-08-04 read through USDYOracleWrapper 0x87b126e5518b6a1Bb8465779b4607C45C643DF90. This is a textbook accrual index and Ix is exact for the compounding. Ix does NOT name where the rate comes from; that is F3.

nodes.label: F3 the rate and the fund price are determinations the issuer makes off-ch
nodes.text: the rate and the fund price are determinations the issuer makes off-chain and then publishes on-chain, once per business day, by hand, from a conservative estimate that is corrected the next day
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: Sv is added to the corpus record and is the largest single omission in it. Ondo pushes OUSG NAV once every business day between 4-6pm ET, states that this is a manual process that may take longer, and uses a conservative estimate of the net income it expects trued up the next day. The legacy OUSG oracle was bounded to plus or minus 74 bps against SHV; the current oracle 0x9Cad45a8BF0Ed41Ff33074449B357C7a1fAb4094 carries no documented sanity band. Ex is APPROXIMATE in the marker sense the corpus already records: this is a single-publisher assertion by the obligor, not a medianizer or an adversarial feed.

nodes.label: F4 a sibling token holds price at one dollar and changes nominal balances
nodes.text: a sibling token holds price at one dollar and changes nominal balances instead, rebasing on the same daily schedule
nodes.note: rUSDY, live supply 11,862,015.98. Rb is exact. The rebase is coincident with the price update, so the two accounting forms are the same determination in two dresses.

nodes.label: F5 an OUSG subscriber becomes a limited partner in a Delaware fund and th
nodes.text: an OUSG subscriber becomes a limited partner in a Delaware fund and the token is a unitized limited partnership interest
nodes.note: Live OndoOracle.getAssetPrice(OUSG) = 116.118574; supply 1,429,129.29, so about $165.9M on Ethereum against a stated portfolio of $378,543,269. Sh is right here and only here. The corpus marker stands: the pool the token is pro-rata OF is off-chain and the contract cannot enumerate it.

nodes.label: F6 the price of every tokenised-equity trade is fixed by an off-chain quo
nodes.text: the price of every tokenised-equity trade is fixed by an off-chain quote the issuer signs, valid for about thirty seconds, carrying a replay identifier, and consumed by the mint or redeem call
nodes.note: DEPARTURE and APPROXIMATE, both stated. The corpus and stage 1 both treated this as residue under Ex, on the ground that Ex assumes a readable external datum while this is a capability grant. Neither considered Rf, which names a signed maker quote consumed on-chain and is the closer symbol: the EIP-712 Quote struct with attestationId and expiration is documented at https://docs.ondo.finance/api-reference/smart-contracts.md and consumed by mintWithAttestation / redeemWithAttestation. The approximation is real and must be recorded: in Rf the maker is one of several competing market makers and the quote prices a secondary trade; here the maker is the issuer, is the only counterparty, prices the PRIMARY issuance of its own liability, and sets the spread by proprietary considerations it declines to publish.

nodes.label: F7 the atomic path is not self-contained: every tokenised-equity mint or
nodes.text: the atomic path is not self-contained: every tokenised-equity mint or redeem requires a live artefact from the issuer's attestation service, and settlement into a stablecoin depends on a swapper holding inventory
nodes.note: RESIDUE. The on-chain code is atomic and the system is not. USDC settlement is available only provided there is enough liquidity in the stablecoin swapper, so a holder can be stuck in the issuer's own dollar token indefinitely. Nothing in the vocabulary marks an on-chain operation whose liveness depends on an off-chain signer, and nothing marks a settlement leg contingent on a third party's inventory.

nodes.label: F8 a holder may redeem, but the right is conditional: on registry members
nodes.text: a holder may redeem, but the right is conditional: on registry membership on-chain, on the issuer's diligence off-chain, on a non-US bank account for the wire rail, and the issuer may refuse a redemption it suspects is non-compliant
nodes.note: APPROXIMATE. Rd asserts a redemption right; every Ondo redemption is conditional and one product has no cash rail at all. The on-chain gate is USDY_InstantManager reverting with UserNotRegistered for an address absent from OndoIDRegistry. The document is explicit that a secondary-market buyer may fail the diligence and therefore may not be able to redeem.

nodes.label: F9 the instant channel is capacity-limited, fifty million dollars globall
nodes.text: the instant channel is capacity-limited, fifty million dollars globally and twenty-five million per investor per rolling twenty-four hours, and is additionally limited by a third party's stablecoin availability
nodes.note: RESIDUE. Above the threshold an atomic right becomes a next-business-day one against a 4pm ET cut-off. Wq is REFUTED here rather than approximate: there is no queue, no ordering, no position and no claim on the next release. This is a soft rationing boundary and the vocabulary has no symbol for a right that degrades by size rather than being denied.

nodes.label: F10 the issuer operates a one-for-one swap module between its own dollar t
nodes.text: the issuer operates a one-for-one swap module between its own dollar token and USDC, gated by a whitelist and bounded by the module's inventory
nodes.note: DEPARTURE: the corpus omits Ps and Ondo names it in its own address register as the Ondo PSM (Peg Stability Module) for USDon, at USDonManager 0x05CCbB4b74854f8A067b83475E8c34f5a413D7e1. Live USDon supply 29,998,093.04. Two qualifications the symbol does not carry: by default users are not whitelisted to swap, and all tokenised-equity trades must settle through USDon, so the swap is not an optional convenience but a mandatory intermediation step, which nothing names.

nodes.label: F11 transfers are gated by an identity determination made off-chain and en
nodes.text: transfers are gated by an identity determination made off-chain and enforced in the token's transfer hook, under three different regimes across the three products
nodes.note: APPROXIMATE, and the flattening is the finding. OUSG runs a true allowlist: CashKYCSenderReceiver requires msg.sender, from and to all to be KYC'd, with membership in OndoIDRegistry whose state is mapping(rwaToken => mapping(user => bytes32 userID)), binding an address to an off-chain identity PER TOKEN. The tokenised equities run a DENYLIST only, so anyone not blocked may hold one and only a KYC'd party may mint or redeem. USDY runs a pass-through stub (F12). A single Aw flattens a permissioned fund, a bearer instrument and a dormant-gate hybrid into one symbol, and it cannot express a per-token identity keyspace. Verified source of the OUSG implementation at https://eth.blockscout.com/api/v2/smart-contracts/0x1B19C19393e2d034D8Ff31ff34c81252FcBbee92 (accessed 2026-08-04).

nodes.label: F12 the USDY gate is installed, wired into the transfer hook and deliberat
nodes.text: the USDY gate is installed, wired into the transfer hook and deliberately switched off, and one role-holder can re-arm it in a single transaction with no delay
nodes.note: RESIDUE, and it deserves its own symbol. Live USDY.allowlist() returns 0x5cd9e3a4c9933133b512da1b6ba4672160e0c665, whose verified source is contract AllowlistStub with isAllowed(address) returning true unconditionally; confirmed behaviourally against a never-transacted address. setAllowlist(address) is callable by LIST_CONFIGURER_ROLE, member count 1, with no timelock. This is the mechanism behind the permissionless-yieldcoin marketing. Neither permissioned nor permissionless describes it, and Aw has no notion of a gate's default or of its re-armability.

nodes.label: F13 the issuer can immobilise a holder's balance in both directions, by bl
nodes.text: the issuer can immobilise a holder's balance in both directions, by blocklist and by a live sanctions oracle, and can destroy it, but cannot reassign it to anyone
nodes.note: CANDIDATE-REGISTER (Fz), and HALF RIGHT as the corpus states it. Freeze is confirmed: Blocklist 0xd8c8174691d936E2C80114EC449037b13421B0a8 plus the Chainalysis sanctions oracle plus pausability, all evaluated in _beforeTokenTransfer on msg.sender, from and to.
